attachments.why: 21H461's offline_compilation_manifest names its 542 non-generic states over m/2 (472) and mw/3 (70) alone, as every 21H461 device-drawn state in corpus.log does (378 m/2, 139 mw/3)
attachments.needs_why: the fewest attachments a texture function's fragment writes: caspec._function_targets targets colour attachment 2 for texture functions 0x4f..0x59 (tfi bit 4), so all 11 path coverage/clear/blit functions exist on mw/3 only

S.why: every non-generic state in 21H461's manifest and os=21H461 corpus writes attachment 0 or 1; named functions without fragment_shader_type_info byte 8 bit 6 write attachment 0 only

u.why: derived from caspec._attachment_format(s, index) in (RGBA16Float, RGBA32Float) for fixed-family states (on 21H461 attachment 1 derives from s.P rather than being RGBA16Float unconditionally, so P=80 S=1 keeps u=0 as every 21H461 manifest and corpus state does); on attachment 0 a seed drawn with u=1 on BGRA8 (4 harvested states with blends llt/sbt/div/cdg) keeps its own beside; never set for named functions

n.why: dither noise flag (fc_has_noise_tex / fc_noise_width) on fixed-family states and named functions with fragment_shader_type_info byte 8 bit 5 set

s.why: HDR headroom scale flag (fc_has_hdr_scale), fixed family

p.why: texture premultiply flag (fc_has_premultiply), fixed-family states with a textured image (image_plane_count > 0 and M < 0)

e.why: EDR factor flag (fc_has_edr_factor), fixed-family states with an image

F.why: 21H461's TextureFilter table and texture_filter_info match the 9 shader filter codes (4..11 plus 0 for <4), applied only to fixed-family textured images (image_plane_count > 0, M < 0); nr and bx cross with the 16-way (n, s, p, e) flag cube, and the remaining 7 filters vary each textured slot over clean and single-flag contexts plus the seed's own flags

D.why: every known 21H461 state in the manifest and corpus has destination function id
